sentences.en: The allies defeated the evil empire in the fierce battle.
sentences.zh: 盟友击败了邪恶帝国，在激烈的战斗中取得了胜利。

sentences.en: Those people are political allies and will help each other.
sentences.zh: 那些人是政治上的盟友，并且会互相帮助。

sentences.en: The Allies continued to build up their forces in France.
sentences.zh: 盟军继续在法国增派兵力。

senses.zh: 同盟国；同盟者；助手；伙伴 -
